newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares down but rebound around the corner.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares down but rebound around the corner.

text.p: Danish share prices closed down on Friday, but dealers said it was a temporary dip while players took profits after Thursday's near-record gains.

"Today's fall should be seen in the light of the advances on Thursday. Sentiment is still good and the U.S. market is reacting positively to this afternoon's employment figures so we can have another good day on Monday," a trader said.
The KFX top-20 index fell 0.29 point to 158.14, in overall bourse turnover of 1.26 billion crowns.
The KFX March future fell 0.05 point to 157.50 with 552 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
SAS was the day's most-traded share with turnover of 215,000.
Interest stemmed from reports that the airline is losing market share in key areas. The share fell 1.50 crowns to 75.50 and dealers saw it under continued pressure in the short term.

Non-KFX Phoenix Contractors'C-share rose 10 crowns to 710, with 108,000 shares traded. Norwegian suitor Rieber and Son earlier raised its bid for the company to match rival Icopal's 710 crowns per share. Icopal was unchanged at 1,150 crowns.
